decisions.mark: names derive_scope in clew/scope.py as where the decision is resolved
states that a repository's own declared index_scope is preferred, and that every failure to find one falls through to indexing the whole repository
conveys that the fallback carries a REASON explaining which scope was used and why, so an unstated scope is never silently guessed

states that a Doxyfile's own INPUT is deliberately NOT used to decide the indexed tree, and explains why — a repository that ships one would get only its documented subset while a repository that ships none gets its whole tree
states that nested git trees are INDEXED and tagged rather than excluded from the scope
conveys that the containment call was REMOVED rather than left in place with its callers dropped
